history.perspective: Prayer-time timezone-of-location vs device-timezone (A1, cycle 4 first live pass)
history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED, significant: PrayerTimesScreen and HomeScreen both fetch prayer timings once on mount with no re-trigger on day rollover while mounted. Combined with fmtCountdown's past-target clamp, this silently gets stuck at 0m forever once nextPrayer's one-day fallback is exhausted. Live-reproduced via mock GPS (Tokyo) + forced device timezone (America/New_York), simulating a realistic traveler scenario. Fixed both screens by extending their existing per-tick intervals to detect date rollover and refetch. Ruled out a third occurrence (prayer-timings-provider.ts) by reading - it's architecturally immune (recomputes date fresh every call, cache-keyed).
